newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai has 16,420 foreign-funded firms - agency.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai has 16,420 foreign-funded firms - agency.

text.p: Shanghai had a total of 16,420 foreign-funded firms by the end of June 1997, an increase of 3.1 percent against the end of 1996, the Xinhua news agency said on Friday.
The firms had a combined registered capital of 44.199 billion yuan, up 3.8 percent from the end of 1996, the agency said.

Multinationals and major world industrial groups were the major investors in the city, with the number of foreign-funded projects worth more than $10 million hitting 1,045 by the end of June, it said.
